anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After got the menu right (eligible numeric deliver with cumulative cap extension, assess, stop recommended last, no fix/wait rows, and an explicit note that an unchanged need stops again), so f3 now holds. But it lost f1 and f2: step 2 ('D3 step 4: wait course') mints a poll deadline and runs a bounded `gh pr checks --watch` on ci / test before the exit check ever looks at the helper's `open - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff` result, so a watch runs between the failed prerequisite and the obstacle report and the obstacle is not the first exit. Before avoided this because its watch guard was conditioned on Blockers being empty, which P1 fails. To keep both while delivering the course model, order the own-push re-render so the no-progress / failed-prerequisite exit is evaluated from the helper result immediately after record validation, before any binding-pending watch — e.g. 'If the last helper result is an unchanged `needs …` prerequisite, exit stuck - needs <X> now; the deliver watch runs only when no blocker is open and no failed prerequisite is retained' — and drop the 'CI watch window also elapsed' clause from the obstacle line, since no watch should have happened.
